title: Fläche_side-2c
slide_intent: Add a second plane deliberately so emphasis increases without obscuring the direction of travel.
strategic_value: The red-and-white horizontal sequence can give DB bold content a more expressive transition.
demonstration: A red plane and white trailing strip travel from left to right across the field.
practical_value: Choose two-color horizontal motion when a bold message supports a more expressive transition.

content_islands.name: Leading plane
content_islands.spec: Move the red field across the frame from the left.

content_islands.name: Trailing plane
content_islands.spec: Follow it with the white strip along the same axis.

reference_purposes.Expression: A red plane and white trailing strip travel from left to right across the field.
reference_purposes.Application: The source provides a playable demonstration of this repeatable sequence: A red plane and white trailing strip travel from left to right across the field.
reference_purposes.Intent: Accompanying Flächenverhalten prose says clear axes and straight movement keep focus on content; two-color variants add expression for bold content.
